meta.title: Xenoblade Chronicles 3 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition - Nintendo Official Site
meta.description: Experience Xenoblade Chronicles 3 enhanced for Nintendo Switch 2. Play in 4K at 60fps with a new Hero, defensive battles, and fully voiced scenes.

content.value: Live to fight. Fight to live.

Join Noah and Mio, members of the two opposing nations of Keves and Agnus, on a heartfelt journey through a warring world with a dark secret. Traverse massive, fantastical landscapes and master seamless real-time RPG combat as you expose the true enemy pulling the strings.
This journey has been enhanced to run at up to 4K* resolution in TV mode, and full HD in handheld mode, at 60 frames per second with smoother and sharper cutscenes.

lottie.fieldName: PMP: Xenoblade Chronicles 3 NS2 Edition PMP intro BG LOTTIE

content.value: Strike an unlikely alliance
These fate-defying soldiers on opposite sides of an eternal conflict must shelve their distrust and work together to learn the truths of their world.
Noah
As a Keves soldier, he wields a bright red blade in combat. He is also an “off-seer”—someone who ferries the souls of fallen soldiers back to their Queen.
Mio
Her speed on the battlefield allows her to easily evade attacks while dealing damage with her ring-shaped weapons. Like Noah, Mio is an “off-seer.”
Eunie
A soldier of Keves who fights alongside her childhood friends Noah and Lanz. Equipped with a cane-shaped weapon called a Gunrod, Eunie is quick to heal up any allies in need.
Taion
A soldier of Agnus who commands paper-like weapons. He acts as a tactician on the battlefield, using his smarts and intellect to support his allies.
Lanz
A childhood friend of Noah and a fellow Keves soldier. His strength allows him to wield a large sword that doubles as a shield.
Sena
This pint-sized soldier of Agnus possesses outsized strength to wallop foes with her giant hammer.
Heroes

Brave residents of Aionios can lend their arms and aptitude to your team as a seventh party member. Only one of these heroes can take to the battlefield at a time, but you can swap them out as you see fit. Complete their Hero Quest to unlock their unique Class to your party members.
Pair up and fight as one
By joining together in battle via Interlinking, specific pairs of characters in your party can fuse to become a fiercely powerful creature known as an Ouroboros.
Change who's in charge to modify the form and Arts of the Ouroboros to fit your approach.
Enter seamless real-time RPG combat
Make your approach

Draw your weapon when encountering an enemy to seamlessly enter battle. Make your approach to attack automatically, then harness powerful abilities called Arts to strive for victory. Freely swap the character you are controlling to fit your combat style and strategy.
Be smart. Use Arts!

Special attacks known as Arts are unique to your character’s Class and Ouroboros form. Keep proper positioning in mind when striking to deal higher damage or apply debuffs. Land successive blows to create devastating Chain Attacks.
Tailor your party
Customize your characters with Classes, Arts, gems, and accessories at any time to create a party that suits your style and needs. Max out a Class Rank to earn its powerful Master Art.
Enhance your journey

Enjoy new gameplay features and content available only in the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. Experience up to 4K* resolution in TV mode and full HD in handheld mode, all at a snappy 60 frames per second—including smoother and sharper cutscenes.
Recruit a mythical new Hero
Shimmer is a speedy Attacker who can unleash devastating rapid-fire combos on her foes. Wielding the power of Foresight, she can see the future. Add her to your adventure by completing her quest.
Test your strength in the Heroes’ Vault mode

Defeat as many enemies as you can in a new defensive battle mode. Enhance your abilities, gain allies, and tackle waves of enemies to fill a gauge that strengthens your forces. Choose wisely—you’ll need to prepare well to defeat the almighty foe awaiting you at the end!
Experience fully voiced events
From the heat of battle to heartfelt moments between characters, immerse yourself in the journey with the addition of even more spoken dialogue.
Enjoy improved resolutions and framerate

Experience the adventure like never before in up to 4K* resolution in TV mode. Take in crisp full HD in handheld mode, too. At 60 frames per second, traversing fantastical landscapes is more fluid than ever.
Explore a rich immersive world

Forge your own path across stunning sci-fi landscapes brimming with discoveries. Scour the world to discover locations, treasures, heroes, and unique monsters. Along your journey, you may even notice a few familiar sights...
Aionios

Host to vast landscapes like grassy plains, lakes, forests, snowscapes, oceans, and waterfalls—all filled with surreal landmarks and diverse wildlife. Its natural splendor stands in contrast to the grisly conflict waged here.
Colonies

These military settlements for the nations of Keves and Agnus are spread throughout the land. There, you can cook, craft gems to strengthen your abilities, and take up quests to help the residents with everyday tasks. At the center of each lies a Ferronis, a mobile base capable of devastating destruction.
Masked Queens
Shadowy rulers lead Keves and Agnus—but to what end? For the people of Aionios, receiving a Homecoming ceremony in front of their Queen is the highest honor.

content.value: Broaden your horizons with the Xenoblade Chronicles 3 Expansion Pass

Unlock additional content with the Xenoblade Chronicles 3 Expansion Pass paid DLC, featuring additional Hero Quests and recruitable heroes, an exciting Challenge Battle mode, and "Future Redeemed”—a thrilling original adventure and culmination of the Xenoblade Chronicles series.
Full version of game required to use DLC. Sold separately.
Experience it all on Nintendo Switch 2
This game is the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. It includes the Nintendo Switch game plus the upgrade pack**, which adds more features and enhancements for play on Nintendo Switch 2.
Already have the game for Nintendo Switch?
Go for just the upgrade pack to enhance your game!

Product:{\"sku\":\"7100122696\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Join Noah and Mio, members of the two opposing nations of Keves and Agnus, on a heartfelt journey through a warring world with a dark secret. Traverse massive, fantastical landscapes and master seamless real-time RPG combat that has all been enhanced to run at 4K* resolution in TV mode, and full HD in handheld mode, at 60 frames per second with smoother and sharper cutscenes.

The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition also features some additional content, including newly voiced event scenes!

Command six characters—including a mythical new Hero—and seamlessly enter real-time RPG combat

All six of your core party members jump into action against enemies, auto-attacking with their distinct arts and weapons. Position your team to take advantage of Arts and maximize damage and debuffs. Pairs of characters can Interlink to form a mighty Ouroboros capable of taking down the most threatening enemies with powerful Arts.

The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition also adds the mythical new Hero, Shimmer to join you on your adventure! Shimmer is a speedy Attacker who can unleash devastating rapid-fire combos on her foes. She also wields the power of Foresight to see the future!

Test your strength against waves of enemies in Heroes’ Vault mode

Defeat as many enemies as you can in a defensive battle mode, exclusive to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. The more enemies you defeat, the more you’ll fill a gauge that you can use to strengthen your forces. Enhance your abilities, gain additional allies, but choose wisely—you’ll need to prepare well to defeat the almighty foe awaiting you at the end!

Already have Xenoblade Chronicles™ 3 for Nintendo Switch? Purchase the upgrade pack!

If you already have the game for Nintendo Switch, you can purchase the upgrade pack** separately to enjoy all the performance enhancements and additions of the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition, including the additional Hero and Heroes’ Vault mode.
